Role : Agentic AI

Exp range: 6-10 years

Location: Pan India





Must-Have

• AI Agentic experience using Python, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and AI Agent frameworks.

Experience or strong interest in AI Agent building / Agentic AI frameworks
Exposure to LLMs, GenAI, RAG, automation, APIs, and enterprise integrations.



Good-to-Have

• Strong hands-on experience in Python development

Ability to convert business use cases into working AI prototypes or production solutions
Passion for innovation, problem-solving, and rapid experimentation.

• solving complex business problems, experimenting with emerging AI technologies, and building scalable, production-ready AI solution




Note : We are currently looking for candidates with an official 90-day notice period and are not considering immediate joiners. If you are comfortable with the JD and meet this criteria, please apply.
